requirements.requirement: The system must validate cache entries against schema (required fields, types, and version) before returning them.
The system must treat cache entries with missing required fields as invalid and trigger recomputation.
The system must detect expired cache entries using TTL and treat them as cache misses.
The system must detect version mismatches between cache entries and current schema version and trigger recomputation.
The system must recompute quality scores when a cache miss or invalid entry is encountered and return the computed result in the same request.
The system must persist recomputed results back into the cache after fallback execution completes successfully.
The system must ensure that cache read failures (e.g., database errors or timeouts) do not propagate errors to the user and instead trigger recomputation.
The system must return a valid evaluation response even when cache access fails completely.
The system must ignore partially populated cache entries and recompute full results instead of merging partial data.
The system must log cache validation failures, corruption detection, and fallback events for observability.
The system must ensure that fallback recomputation produces results consistent with non-cached execution paths.
The system must prevent returning stale or invalid cache data under any failure condition.
